narrative: 笑点和梦境般的旅行：纪录片式的镜头、悬崖、浪花，一只会飞或栖息着的海鸟充当引擎。骑海豚始终停留在水中。
骑企鹅始终停留在冰面或城市雪泥上。骑海鹦则可以离开水面，因为这只鸟会飞——如果你依然把它当作一次通勤来演，这就是额外的笑点。
对于一部尊重海鹦聚居地的野生动物纪录片，它是错误的工具；如果这只鸟只是出现在背景里，也是错误的用法。骑乘着。
在移动。空中有水花飞溅。
how: 广角，画面中有悬崖，24mm到35mm焦段，骑乘者的高度或岩石上略低的位置。北大西洋式的阴天光线，或硬质的海岸阳光。
动物清晰可辨，橙色的喙，人骑在上面。Still: Puffin-ride of [Subject], an absurd seabird mount, cliffs and spray, a commute on the wrong bird.
提示词：Video: [Subject] rides a puffin against cliffs or surf, a straight-faced gag.
when: 一次笑点式的通勤、一场不可能为真的悬崖旅游。不要把它当作徒步者加海鹦式的野生动物静帧来用。
vs: 骑企鹅是冰面和一只不会飞的坐骑。骑海豚是明亮的水面和鲸豚类动物。
骑海鹦是悬崖、水花，一只会飞的海鸟，遵循同样的明信片法则。如果没有悬崖也没有喙，你选错了动物。
examples_film: 目前没有公认的骑海鹦经典影片。可以从北大西洋野生动物题材的拍摄中借鉴悬崖与浪花的语法，把这次骑乘演绎成病毒式传播的不可能旅游体验。
mistakes: 一只海鹦站在徒步者旁边，或把一只在冰上的企鹅误标成这个风格。破绽是没有骑乘，或选错了鸟。
修正方法：人骑在海鹦身上，有悬崖，有水花，这次通勤演得一本正经。

faq.q: 电影中的骑海鹦（Puffin Ride）是什么？
faq.a: 一个不带笑意的骑乘笑点，骑的是一只海鹦，通常衬着悬崖和浪花。这只鸟就是引擎。一张野生动物陪伴镜头不算数。

faq.q: 骑海鹦（Puffin Ride）与骑企鹅（Penguin Ride）的区别
faq.a: 骑企鹅是冰面或城市，不会飞。骑海鹦是悬崖和一只会飞的海鸟。同样的明信片法则，不同的地理和动物。
笑点和梦境般的悬崖通勤。跳过追求尊重感的海鹦纪录片。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写骑海鹦的提示词？
faq.a: 先写悬崖、骑乘中的[Subject]，视频则是[Subject]骑着海鹦穿过悬崖或浪花。表情投入认真。

narrative: Gags and dream travel: documentary camera, cliffs, surf, a flying or perched seabird as engine. Dolphin ride stays in water.
Penguin ride stays on ice or city slush. Puffin ride can leave the water because the bird can fly, which is the extra joke if you still play it as a commute.
It is the wrong tool for wildlife films that respect puffin colonies, and the wrong tool if the bird is only in the background. Mounted.
how: Wide, cliffs in frame, 24mm to 35mm, rider height or a little below on the rock. Overcast North-Atlantic light or hard coastal sun.
Animal readable, orange beak, person mounted. Still: Puffin-ride of [Subject], an absurd seabird mount, cliffs and spray, a commute on the wrong bird.
Video: [Subject] rides a puffin against cliffs or surf, a straight-faced gag.
when: A gag commute, cliff tourism that cannot be true. Do not use it as a hiker-plus-puffin wildlife still.
vs: Penguin Ride is ice and a flightless mount. Dolphin Ride is bright water and a cetacean.
Puffin ride is cliffs, spray, a seabird that can fly, same postcard law. If there is no cliff and no beak, you are on the wrong animal.
examples_film: There is no canonical puffin-ride feature. Borrow cliff-and-spray grammar from North-Atlantic wildlife coverage and play the mount as viral impossible tourism.
mistakes: A puffin next to a hiker, or a penguin on ice labeled as this. The tell is no mount, or the wrong bird.
Fix it: they are on the puffin, cliffs, spray, commute played straight.

faq.q: What is Puffin Ride in film?
faq.a: A straight-faced mount gag on a puffin, usually against cliffs and spray. The bird is the engine. A wildlife companion shot does not count.
Penguin ride is ice or city, flightless. Puffin ride is cliffs and a flying seabird. Same postcard law, different geography and animal.

faq.q: When should I use Puffin Ride?
faq.a: Gags and dream cliff commutes. Skip respectful puffin documentaries.

faq.q: How do I prompt Puffin Ride for AI image or video?
faq.a: Cliffs, mounted [Subject], then: Puffin-ride of [Subject], an absurd seabird mount, cliffs and spray, a commute on the wrong bird. Video: [Subject] rides a puffin against cliffs or surf. Face committed.
